# Catalog state

Every current-state number about the catalog, read from the live database.

**Do not edit this file, and do not copy these numbers into prose.** Link here
instead. Numbers written into sentences have no way to notice the world moved,
which is how three documents came to disagree about the catalog on 2026-07-28.

Regenerate, and check nothing has drifted:

```
./node_modules/.bin/tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/catalog-state.ts
git diff --exit-code docs/catalog-state.md
```

There is no generated-at line on purpose: without one, the file only changes
when the data changes, so that diff is a real staleness check. Git's commit
date is the freshness record.

## Pipeline coverage

One row per step that stamps a column, from the `STEP_DEFS` registry in
`apps/web/scripts/round-status.ts`. A step added there appears here automatically.

**`owed` is not a synonym for the gap.** A `catalog` step is owed by every
row whenever it was seeded, so a shortfall there is work. A `forward` step is
owed only by rows seeded after it existed; older rows are settled, not
behind, and its shortfall is reported for information. The classification
and the reasoning per step live on `StepDef.obligation`, and every `forward`
step carries a witness in `check-pipeline-invariants.ts` that fails the day
its data becomes something a reader can see.

| `cross-check-plants` | `botanical_checked_at` | catalog | 664 / 780 | 85.1% |
